description: Marquages routiers - Textes complémentaires is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Genf. Cette couche fait partie du cadastre des marquages routiers, mise à disposition dans le groupe de couches 'MARQUAGES ROUTIERS'. La couche "TEXTES COMPLÉMENTAIRES" comporte les textes et indications utiles à la réalisation des marquages et apportent une meilleure compréhension des plans. ! Donnée de type ANNOTATION ESRI ! Coverage: Kanton Genf. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Genf. It offers 7 resource(s) in API, CSV, GML, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
